stories.title: Las Vegas Marathon returns in January with new signature course
stories.summary: The Las Vegas Marathon will return Jan. 10 for its third consecutive year, debuting a new course that brings the full 26.2-mile marathon distance back to the Las Vegas Strip.

stories.title: Cincinnati Zoo says Fiona the hippo has died, days after ingesting a visitor’s hat
stories.summary: Fiona, the hippo whose premature birth and fight for survival at the Cincinnati Zoo turned her into a global sensation nearly a decade ago, died Thursday from complications after swallowing a knit hat that was accidentally flung into her enclosure.

stories.title: More than half of Hawaiʻi households living on financial brink
